scope.rationale: D176.7 adds conditional-construction capture in the JSON-only preparer (QueryCommand.QueryPreparer.cs): a ConditionalExpression with a translatable predicate and a New/MemberInit arm lowers the construction as a scoped object plus a hidden nullable sentinel column, using the existing AnyColumnNotNull presence rule. The affected tests are the direct recursive-writer tests (core JsonShapeWriterTests, which prove the sentinel-only presence decision at the writer level) and the end-to-end SQLite JsonStreamingTests (which exercise the real preparer and SQL CASE lowering). No other product source is changed.
